description: ifremer.fr: port and maritime datasets is a collection of datasets listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by ifremer.fr. Coverage: the area served by ifremer.fr. The listing groups 5 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about port and maritime; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Carte des formations superficielles sous-marines entre Port-Barcarès e; Nature du trait de côte de Seine-Maritime; Photos anciennes - Charente Maritime - Ile de Ré en 1950; Nature de l'estran de Seine-Maritime. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
